messages.cloudflare.connection.auth-help: Use a Cloudflare API Token. The identity check calls /user/tokens/verify. Do not use the Global API Key email header. Listing domains also requires Zone.Read.
messages.cloudflare.oauth.api-scopes: Approved read-only API scopes (space-separated, dot syntax)
messages.cloudflare.oauth.note: Choose the required read-only permissions from the official OAuth Scopes API. Do not use the colon syntax for Wrangler scopes.
